=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
<syntaxhighlight lang="freebasic">dim p as ulongint
for n as uinteger = 1 to 50
    p = n
    for i as uinteger = 2 to n/2
        if n mod i = 0 then p *= i
    next i
    print p,
next n
</syntaxhighlight>
